name: Tchibo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Tchibo in Kufstein**

Discover the world of coffee and more at **Tchibo** in the charming town of **Kufstein**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just a short stroll from the historic **Kaiserliche Burg** (Imperial Castle) and the scenic **Inn River**, our cozy café offers a perfect blend of relaxation and quality.

Indulge in freshly brewed **Tchibo** coffee, paired with delicious pastries like **Apfelstrudel** or a slice of **Sachertorte**. For a hearty breakfast, try our **Kaiserschmarrn** with a side of **Speck** and fresh fruit.

Whether you're planning a day trip to nearby **Innsbruck** or exploring the stunning **Zillertal Alps**, start your adventure with a warm cup of coffee at **Tchibo in Kufstein**. We look forward to welcoming you!
